title: The Fatal Deployment at SynthAI
synopsis: Viktor Kane, founder of hot unicorn SynthAI, collapsed dead in the server bunker during a midnight release. An insulin overdose triggered by remote tampering was masked by the datacenter freeze.
noisy_case_file:
INCIDENT DOSSIER - SAN FRANCISCO POLICE DEPT
Incident: Suspicious Death / Cyber-Homicide
Location: SynthAI HQ, 4th Floor Server Bunker, SOMA, San Francisco
Time of Discovery: 12:20 AM, Friday | Lead Investigator: Det. Sarah Chen

Background & Scene Details:
SynthAI was preparing for its Series C funding announcement and v2 model weights release at 1:00 AM. Catering had delivered 12 boxes of cold pepperoni pizza and brown sugar boba milk teas at 10:30 PM. The office was bustling with tired engineers playing ping-pong in the lounge and arguing over git merge conflicts in #release-war-room.

Victim: Viktor Kane (Age 34), CEO & Chief AI Architect. Diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes; wore a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and an automated Bluetooth-connected OmniDose insulin pump. Found unresponsive on the grating floor of Server Pod C, where temperatures are kept at a frigid 15°C (59°F). Paramedics pronounced him dead at 12:28 AM from acute severe hypoglycemia induced by a massive 50-unit insulin bolus.

Server Room Access & Tech Logs:
- 11:15 PM: Viktor logged into workstation Alpha-1, drinking a zero-sugar sparkling water.
- 11:40 PM: Viktor entered Server Pod C with his biometric badge to manually check GPU cluster temperatures.
- 11:48 PM: Datacenter Bluetooth gateway logged an unauthorized pairing attempt with device 'OmniDose-VK99' from MAC address F4:D4:88:9A:12:FE (hostname 'ML-Air-M3'). Bolus override executed, injecting 50 units of fast-acting Lispro.
- 11:55 PM: Fire alarm in Sector B briefly tripped due to an overworked cooling manifold valve blowing dry nitrogen gas.

Suspect Profiles & Interrogations:
1. Maya Lin (Co-Founder & VP of Product): Claims she was locked inside Conference Room Echo hosting a live pitch to London venture capitalists on Zoom between 11:30 PM and 12:15 AM. London partners verified the call, but noted Maya muted her camera and mic between 11:45 PM and 11:52 PM claiming poor Wi-Fi. Forensic extraction: Hardware MAC address F4:D4:88:9A:12:FE matches Maya Lin's gold MacBook Air. In her designer handbag, detectives found an encrypted SanDisk Extreme SSD containing the complete proprietary neural weights of SynthAI v2 labeled 'Buyer: Apex Venture Beijing'.
2. Devon Park (Lead Infrastructure Engineer): Seen shouting at Viktor at 10:45 PM regarding equity clawback clauses. Sent a message in Slack at 11:10 PM: 'If Kane doesn't fix our vesting schedules, this entire cluster can burn down.' Devon was spotted in the snack kitchen brewing third-wave pour-over coffee continuously from 11:35 PM to 12:05 AM, corroborated by security camera #3.
3. Samira Khan (Head of Security): Was investigating a phishing incident reported by an intern at 11:20 PM. Left her badge on the reception desk between 11:40 PM and 11:50 PM while using the restroom.
4. Garrison Cole (Lead Angel Investor): Present at the office celebrating early. Spilled a glass of champagne over the demo terminal at 11:30 PM, causing a brief breaker switch trip.

ground_truth.weapon_or_method: Remote Bluetooth firmware injection overriding Viktor's OmniDose smart insulin pump with a lethal 50-unit bolus
ground_truth.key_clue: Maya's gold MacBook Air MAC address matched the unauthorized Bluetooth pairing logged at 11:48 PM during the exact 7-minute window she turned off her camera on the London Zoom call, and she possessed an SSD ready to sell SynthAI weights to a competitor
ground_truth.motive: Maya was secretly orchestrating an illegal IP transfer of SynthAI's proprietary model weights to an offshore buyer, which Viktor had uncovered earlier that evening

The fire alarm tripped by the dry nitrogen valve in Sector B
